item.title: Winsford Gardens, 5th August
item.description:

item.title: Traffic light timing disjointed and long delays, 5th August
item.description:
The traffic lights on the junction with the Junction 31 roundabout from both J30 and Arterial Road West Thurrock have been on a long delay and disjointed sequence for a few weeks now creating long delays and jams, causing issues that you can no longer just go round the roundabout and people are trying to use all lanes to escape the box junctions and block everything because the timings have been altered that no longer allow the traffic to flow normally. It used to be that only at night were there very long and unnecessary delays on the whole roundabout, now, even when the crossing is running fairly clear during the day, the roundabout is getting jammed up for no good reason.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Purfleet Interchange, West Thurrock, South Ockendon
